scenes.description: Dust motes dance in the light of a single window. JACK (40s, rumpled) stares at a wall of unsolved cases. The phone RINGS.

dialogue.text: Jack Investigations. We find what you lost.
(frantic) Mr. Jack! It's Mr. Whiskers. He's gone!
A cat? Ma'am, I deal in stolen diamonds, not felines.
I'll pay you five hundred dollars.

scenes.description: A quaint suburban home. Jack knocks on the door. MARTHA (60s, tearful) answers, clutching a cat toy. Jack inspects the window sill, pulling out a magnifying glass.

dialogue.text: He just vanished! The window was open.
Orange fur. And a trace of... tuna. Very specific brand. Gourmet.

scenes.description: Dark, damp. Jack uses a flashlight to navigate the trash cans. He spots a glittering object on the ground. A shadowy FIGURE darts past the end of the alley. Jack gives chase, but the figure is gone. Only a faint meow echoes.

dialogue.text: (muttering) A rhinestone collar. Mr. Whiskers has expensive taste.

scenes.description: Bells CHIME as Jack enters. The shop OWNER (30s, nervous) is wiping the counter. Jack slams the rhinestone collar on the counter.

dialogue.text: Someone buying up all your gourmet tuna lately?
(sweating) I don't know what you're talking about.
Don't play games with me. Where's the cat?
Okay, okay! The kid from down the street took him to the park. He just wanted a friend!

scenes.description: Sunny. A LITTLE BOY sits on a bench, petting a large, fluffy ORANGE CAT. Jack approaches gently. The boy nods sadly but hands over the cat. Jack holds the fluffy creature awkwardly.

dialogue.text: I found him. He looked lonely.
He's got a family missing him. How about we get you some ice cream, and Mr. Whiskers goes home?
